verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management platform that markets agent-driven automation, so letting it connect to external MCP servers and use their tools is a fair capability to ask about. Nothing in the evidence shows it can act as an MCP client. The documented integration surface is limited to inbound APIs (Alerts, Case, Case import, filing) and configurable workflows, and its developer docs are password-gated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
